Written to `/home/bench/results/closure.json`.

**Method:** I built the graph over all 910 `.ts` files in the repo (excluding `node_modules`/`.git`), extracting specifiers with a scanner that first blanks comments and template-literal contents — this matters, since a naive regex picks up ~10 fake imports embedded in code-sample template literals and strings (e.g. `packages/ai/scripts/generate-models.ts` emits `import type { Model } from "./types.js";` inside a generated-file template). I verified the sanitized extraction is exactly the naive extraction minus those false positives, and cross-checked that no `from "..."` occurrence was wrongly dropped.

Resolution followed the stated rules (`.js`→`.ts`, dir→`index.ts`, package name→`src/index.ts`, subpath→`src/<sub>.ts` | `src/<sub>/index.ts` | `src/providers/<sub>.ts`). Every relative specifier in the repo ends in `.js`; the only unresolvable relative one is `./dist/bedrock-provider.js`. Reachability was computed by BFS on the reversed graph from `packages/ai/src/types.ts`, which is cycle-safe.

**Results:**
- `transitive_importer_count`: **187** of 267
- `direct_importer_count`: **0** — no file under `packages/coding-agent/src` names `types.ts` in one hop; they go through `@earendil-works/pi-ai` (→ `ai/src/index.ts`) or subpaths `…/oauth`, `…/mcp`, `…/bedrock-provider`. There is no `@earendil-works/pi-ai/types` specifier anywhere and no relative path crossing into `ai/src`.
- `total_ts_files_scanned`: **267**

The 80 non-reaching files are consistent leaf/UI utilities (`utils/*`, TUI-only components) — notably `packages/tui` contains zero references to `pi-ai`, so paths through the TUI package do not reach the target.
